name: zmodel_dipool_read_entry_by_index_from_stream
description: zModel_DiPool::ReadEntryByIndexFromStream reads one serialized DI slot by index and restores its dynamic data into a free-list allocation.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel DI-pool/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x481aa0 validates header reading, zero-capacity and out-of-range null returns, seeking by index * sizeof(zDiPartial), reading a fixed 0x58-byte slot, allocating from the DI free list, copying the first 0x54 runtime fields, seeking to serialized nextFreeIndex as the dynamic-data offset, cleaning up through FreeIfUnreferenced on dynamic-data read failure, and returning the loaded slot.

The native DI-pool indexed read smoke verifies loading index 1 into the current free-list slot, copied mode/flags/bbox radius, dynamic offset handling for an empty dynamic payload, free-head and in-use updates, and out-of-range null behavior without changing pool state.
